text: Transportation Services is requesting approval, on behalf of the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC), to alter Lawrence Avenue West from Dufferin Street to a point 57 metres (m) east of Corona St./Via Bagnato in order to provide an extended westbound lane for right-turning traffic and through buses. Doing so will allow TTC vehicles to bypass general traffic in this area, improving service reliability. The change has been evaluated for benefits and impacts according to established criteria for queue-jump lane requests. This lane can be accommodated by widening the south side of Lawrence Avenue by up to 2.0m, reducing existing lane widths, and extending existing turn lanes. These modifications will not result in the loss of any travel lanes, as the current two eastbound and two westbound lanes will be maintained.
